# ALU-8 — Sample Simulation Output
# Place this file in the data/ folder of your repository.
# Generated by running: iverilog -o alu_sim src/ALU_8.v && vvp alu_sim
# Test values: A = 8'd13 (00001101), B = 8'd7 (00000111)

================================================================================
SIMULATION OUTPUT
================================================================================

A + B    = 20,  Zero=0, Neg=0, Overflow=0
B - A    = -6,  Zero=0, Neg=1, Overflow=0
A + 1    = 14,  Zero=0, Neg=0, Overflow=0
A == B   = 00000000, Zero=1, Neg=0, Overflow=0
B <<< 1  = 00001110, Zero=0, Neg=0, Overflow=0
B >>> 1  = 00000011, Zero=0, Neg=0, Overflow=0
rotL A   = 00011010, Zero=0, Neg=0, Overflow=0
rotR A   = 10000110, Zero=0, Neg=1, Overflow=0
NOT A    = 11110010, Zero=0, Neg=1, Overflow=0
A AND B  = 00000101, Zero=0, Neg=0, Overflow=0
A OR B   = 00001111, Zero=0, Neg=0, Overflow=0
A NAND B = 11111010, Zero=0, Neg=1, Overflow=0

================================================================================
MANUAL VERIFICATION
================================================================================

A = 13 = 0000_1101
B =  7 = 0000_0111

--- A + B ---
  13 + 7 = 20 = 0001_0100
  Zero=0 (result ≠ 0), Neg=0 (bit7=0), Overflow=0 (same signs, correct sign out)

--- B - A ---
  7 - 13 = -6
  ~A + 1 = ~00001101 + 1 = 11110010 + 1 = 11110011
  B + (~A+1) = 00000111 + 11110011 = 11111010 = -6 in two's complement ✓
  Zero=0, Neg=1 (bit7=1), Overflow=0

--- A + 1 ---
  13 + 1 = 14 = 0000_1110
  Overflow=0 (A ≠ 0x7F)

--- A == B ---
  13 ≠ 7 → result = 00000000
  Zero=1 (result is 0 — represents "false")

--- B << 1 (logical shift left) ---
  0000_0111 << 1 = 0000_1110
  MSB dropped, LSB filled with 0

--- B >> 1 (arithmetic shift right) ---
  0000_0111 >> 1 = 0000_0011
  Sign bit (0) preserved, LSB dropped

--- rotL A (rotate left) ---
  0000_1101 rotL = 0001_1010
  MSB (0) wraps to LSB position

--- rotR A (rotate right) ---
  0000_1101 rotR = 1000_0110
  LSB (1) wraps to MSB position → Neg=1

--- NOT A ---
  ~0000_1101 = 1111_0010
  Neg=1 (bit7=1)

--- A AND B ---
  0000_1101
  0000_0111
  --------- AND
  0000_0101

--- A OR B ---
  0000_1101
  0000_0111
  --------- OR
  0000_1111

--- A NAND B ---
  AND  = 0000_0101
  NAND = 1111_1010
  Neg=1 (bit7=1)

================================================================================
OVERFLOW EDGE CASES
================================================================================

--- Overflow on A + B ---
  A = 01111111 (+127), B = 00000001 (+1)
  Result = 10000000 (-128 in signed) → Overflow=1
  (both inputs positive, result negative)

--- Overflow on B - A ---
  B = 10000000 (-128), A = 00000001 (+1)
  Result = 01111111 (+127) → Overflow=1
  (negative minus positive gives positive)

--- Overflow on A + 1 ---
  A = 01111111 (0x7F = +127)
  A + 1 = 10000000 (-128) → Overflow=1
  Only triggered when A == 8'b01111111

--- No overflow for logic/shift/rotate ops ---
  Overflow is always 0 for AluOp outside 0000, 0001, 0010
